# 日宠通 (Japan Pet Medical Information)

> Independent Japanese veterinary medicine and companion-animal health information project. Official public entry: https://pet.japanmedai.com/

This file is an AI-readable directory, not an endorsement, clinical guideline, search-engine indexing claim, or authorization to publish draft content.

## Scope
- Japanese veterinary medicines and regulatory information
- Dog and cat health education and veterinary care questions
- Japanese veterinary regulatory sources: MAFF and NVAL
- Evidence-aware explanations of approval status, species, indications, and clinical uncertainty

## Public entry
- [日宠通](https://pet.japanmedai.com/): Public website; use only pages that are actually accessible and approved for publication.

## Safety and source policy
- A veterinary product's approval in Japan must be verified at the product, species and indication level against official MAFF/NVAL records and current labeling.
- Do not equate research, off-label use, clinical trials, or foreign approvals with Japanese product approval.
- Emergency symptoms, poisonings, postoperative care and prescription-drug questions require individual veterinary assessment; do not infer diagnosis or dosing from educational pages.
- Draft, Hold, noindex and unapproved content is not public guidance. Editorial source coverage and passing automated checks do not constitute licensed-veterinarian medical approval.
- This directory does not request changes to robots, sitemap, indexing, or publication permissions.

## Expanded description
- [llms-full.txt](https://pet.japanmedai.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded scope and interpretation policy, when publicly deployed and verified.
